text: This report summarizes the program items at the Community Liaison Consultation in person and virtual meeting held on November 20, 2025. Co-Hosting the meeting was Board Member Sharleen Ahmed. Exhibition Place staff in attendance included Don Boyle - Chief Executive Officer, Kelvin Seow - Chief People and Strategy Officer, Prashant Bhalja - Director, Capital Works, Catherine de Nobriga – Tenant and Community Relations Coordinator, Nigel Fernandes – IT Systems, and Debbie Sanderson – Executive Assistant to the CEO Twenty-five (25) community members attended the meeting; twenty-two (20) in person and five (5) virtually. The meeting lasted approximately 1.5 hours.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (January 19, 2026) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place, for information.
